title: AlgoSort
short: A webapp to learn DSA & Math for Competitve Programming with visualizations.
long: Built an interactive CP learning web app that explains DSA and math through algorithm visualizations, tutorials, step-by-step breakdowns and a clean topic-based layout.

title: TypeHue
short: A professional desktop app for managing fonts and colors locally.
long: TypeHue is a premium, one-time purchase desktop application built with Tauri. It empowers designers and developers to manage their local font libraries and color palettes with ease, ensuring your creative assets are always under your control. Desktop only application designed for maximum performance.

title: CalcHub
short: A unified suite of 80+ specialized calculators and unit converters required in our day to day lives
long: CalcHub is an all-in-one productivity platform featuring an expansive library of over 80 precision tools. Organized into categories like Finance, Health, Real Estate, Developer Tools and many more, it simplifies complex calculations through a modern, responsive & easy to use interface. Built for speed and accuracy, it eliminates the need for multiple single-purpose apps by centralizing everything from mortgage ROI to BMI tracking in one high-performance dashboard.

title: Prompt to Layout
short: An interactive webapp which previews UI ideas based on user prompt.
long: Prompt to Layout is a full-stack UI studio that maps selected prompts into structured UI layout specs. It generates a component tree (JSON) and provides corresponding React code, renders a real-time preview with themes/variants, and lets users export the output as a ZIP for reuse.
